title: Machine learning finds ribbon-knot certificates and rules out candidate pairs
summary: Bayesian optimization and reinforcement learning search for sequences of knot moves that certify a knot is ribbon. The primary v1 reports that both knots in 843 specified pairs were shown ribbon, eliminating those pairs as potential counterexamples in the studied strategy. It also recovers a separately independently established set of 1,705 ribbon knots; these are not claimed as novel. This does not resolve the smooth four-dimensional Poincaré conjecture.
organization: Dublin Institute for Advanced Studies; Northeastern University; Stanford University
